notes: The process correctly models the request/acknowledge timeout protocol, including initial-edge acknowledgement suppression, exact timeout timing, acknowledgement priority on the final service edge, one-cycle mutually exclusive completion pulses, and ignored requests while an outstanding transaction exists. S4.4 is interpreted causally: a request while busy does not restart, replace, or otherwise influence the active transaction, although busy or cnt may still change because of acknowledgement, timeout, or normal countdown. No material process error is present. Final RTL passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
